failure_modes: No measurable increase in the early positive excursion of landmark_00_local_dx relative to the uniform-dose baseline, or a sign reversal of the early-region contrast (H001 falsifier).

Loss of final predicted target affinity or reduced rare-path coverage despite verified dose delivery, since equal time-integrated ratios do not guarantee equal physical displacement under flow magnitude, gradient cancellation, caps and clash backtracking.
Requested dose not actually delivered: trace checks of requested vs delivered dose must confirm the compiled table changed execution; if the edit did not change execution it must not be credited.

The polynomial fit is rejected and the curve has multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts, so no stable global trend or discovered stage boundary can be claimed; the early-window contrast is a regional association only.

Only one coordinate proxy was read; other landmark coordinates and soft_mass features were not queried, so the temporal picture is incomplete and the early-window hypothesis may not generalize across landmarks.
result.rationale: Analyst H001 states that redistributing guidance dose toward the early portion of the observed window (t≈0.0-0.15) should enlarge the early positive excursion of landmark_00_local_dx, whose observed curve already peaks positively there before reversing (F001, F002). The registered dose recipe W1_early_soft is the offered intervention that matches this direction: its dose schedule [0.35,1,1.65] over knots [0,0.5,1] shifts the ratio budget away from the early nodes toward later nodes, i.e. it is the early-soft control that preserves the M2 reward geometry (delta=[1,1,1], blend=[0,0,0]) and only changes the registered dose factor. H002 (middle negative excursion) is not selected because W2_middle_peak would emphasize the middle, which is the opposite of the early-window hypothesis, and no registered recipe targets the middle trough without also altering the early region. The incumbent coordinate reward, teacher matching, temperatures and frozen eta are preserved; only the registered dose factor changes. This is a dose-route edit, not a reward-family change, and the scalar reward is not merely multiplied.
